errors.incompleteCredentials: Host URL, username and password must all be provided.
errors.passwordRequired: Enter the password to test a host or user other than the saved one. The stored password is only sent to the saved host.
errors.invalidHost: The BioStar 2 Host URL must start with http:// or https://. The app does not connect until this is fixed.

client.tlsCertificate: BioStar 2 uses a certificate Homey cannot verify (__reason__). This is usually a self-signed certificate. If this is your own server on your network, untick "Verify SSL/TLS certificate" and test again.
client.noSessionHeader: BioStar 2 did not return a bs-session-id header.
client.responseTooLarge: The BioStar 2 response was too large.
client.responseIncomplete: The connection closed before the BioStar 2 response was complete.
client.devicesDenied: Permission denied reading devices. Grant this account the Device read permission in BioStar 2.
client.doorsDenied: Permission denied reading doors. Grant this account the Door read permission in BioStar 2.
client.openDoorDenied: Permission denied opening the door. This account can read doors but not control them. In BioStar 2, open the operator permission set assigned to this account and enable Monitoring at Edit level.
client.certificateChanged: The BioStar 2 server now presents a different certificate than the one this app trusts (__fingerprint__). If you renewed or reinstalled BioStar 2, press "Forget trusted certificate" in the settings. If not, do not connect: someone may be intercepting the connection.

notifications.connectionLost: BioStar 2: connection lost. Access events are not reaching Homey.

permWarning.title: Limited permissions.
permWarning.body: This account cannot read user profiles in BioStar 2, so the group, email, department, telephone and login ID tags fall back to the raw event data. Grant the account the Users read permission in BioStar 2 to enable them.

connection.plainHttp: This address uses http://, so the password and all events travel unencrypted over your network. Use https:// where you can.
connection.wsHint: Leave empty to derive it automatically from the host URL.
connection.passwordStored: A password is stored. Leave unchanged to keep it.
connection.ssl: Verify SSL/TLS certificate (uncheck for self-signed certificates)
connection.pinnedHint: With verification off, the app trusts only the certificate it saw at the first successful connection and refuses any other. After renewing or reinstalling BioStar 2, forget it so the new one is trusted.

eventTypes.label: Event types seen
eventTypes.hint: Every event name BioStar 2 has sent since the app started, most frequent first. Tick one to drop it before any processing — that is what keeps the app idle when nothing relevant is happening. Ticked rows never reach your Flows.
eventTypes.empty: No events seen yet. They appear here as BioStar 2 sends them.
eventTypes.manualPlaceholder: Add an event name not listed yet

ignoreSubstrings.label: Ignored event names (contains)
ignoreSubstrings.hint: One per line. Any event whose name contains one of these fragments is dropped.

logUserNames.label: Show user names in the activity log
logUserNames.hint: On by default, because names are what make the log useful when a Flow misbehaves. Turn it off to keep identifiable access data out of the log view — entries then read "User: <hidden>". This only affects the log; Flow tags always carry the real user. The log is kept in memory and cleared when the app restarts, unless you turn on "Keep the log across app restarts" on the Live Logs tab.

clock.label: Show times on a 24-hour clock
clock.hint: Ticked shows 20:50:20, unticked shows 8:50:20 PM. Until you choose, it follows Homey's language — 24 hours for Dutch and French, 12 hours for English. Applies to the whole log, including entries already on screen.

persistLogs.label: Keep the log across app restarts
persistLogs.hint: Writes the log to Homey's internal storage, at most 256 KB, oldest entries dropped first. Writes are batched to spare the flash memory. Turning it off deletes the stored file. Note that this puts access history on disk.

timing.heartbeatHint: How often the app pings BioStar 2. The connection is considered dead after twice this long without a reply.
timing.reconnectHint: The delay grows by 50% after each failed attempt, up to this ceiling.

logs.title: What the app has been doing
logs.intro: Authentications at your readers, Flow actions, connection changes and any errors — newest last. Kept in memory only unless you turn on the option below, so it is normally cleared whenever the app restarts.

messages.savedAdvanced: Advanced settings saved. Reconnecting with the new configuration.
messages.loadFailed: Could not load the stored settings.
messages.forgetConfirm: Forget the trusted certificate? The next successful connection trusts whatever certificate the server then presents.

log.configUpdated: Configuration updated in settings. Restarting client...
log.flowReconnect: Manual BioStar 2 reconnect triggered by Flow Action Card.
log.clock12: Activity log clock switched to 12-hour format.
log.clock24: Activity log clock switched to 24-hour format.
log.persistentLogOff: Persistent log turned off; the stored file has been deleted.
log.persistentLogOn: Persistent log turned on; __count__ stored line(s) restored.
log.notConfigured: Credentials/host not fully configured yet. Please configure in App Settings.
log.hostInvalid: Host URL must start with http:// or https://. Not connecting.
log.hostPlainHttp: Host URL uses http://: the password and all events travel unencrypted. Use https:// where you can.
log.certTrusted: Trusting the certificate of __host__ from now on (SHA-256 __fingerprint__).
log.certForgotten: Trusted certificate forgotten by user. Reconnecting.
log.loginServerFault: BioStar 2 is reachable but rejects every login with HTTP __status__. This is a fault on the BioStar 2 server itself, not in Homey or the network: its web tier is answering while the core service behind it is not. Restart the BioStar 2 services on the server. The app keeps retrying and reconnects on its own once login works again.
log.profileLookupDenied: User profile lookup denied (HTTP __status__) for account '__user__'. Extra user tags (group, email, department, telephone, login ID) will fall back to the raw event data. Grant this account the Users read permission in BioStar 2 to enable them.
log.readerListHidden: Reader list: __count__ reader(s), __hidden__ non-authenticating device(s) hidden.
log.backlogFull: Event backlog full (__max__); dropping the oldest events.
